description: This file defines a React Error Boundary component for handling runtime errors within React components. It captures errors, displays a fallback UI, and provides options to report the error and clear app data.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that catches JavaScript errors anywhere in its child component tree, logs those errors, and displays a fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component with default error state.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Lifecycle method that catches errors thrown in child components and updates the error state.

methods.name: clearAndSaveData
methods.description: Exports data via store, clears local storage, and reloads the page, used to reset app state after an error.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the error UI with options to report or reset, or the child components if no error has occurred.
